VBO:0200861.summary: Playful and adventurous, Bear was a nine-year-old Maltipom whose keeper said she enjoyed exploring outdoors and snuggling on the couch for belly rubs. Food rewards helped her learn sit, stay and “drop it.” The same account described an alert dog who could bark excessively and occasionally become snappy.
VBO:0200861.shortDescription: Bear’s keeper described a playful Maltipom who enjoyed outdoor exploring, couch snuggles and learning with food rewards.
